{"sql": "WITH revenue_by_year AS (
    SELECT 
        so.Channel,
        p.Category,
        d."Fiscal Year",

    FROM Sales s
    JOIN Sales_Order so ON s.SalesOrderLineKey = so.SalesOrderLineKey

            PARTITION BY Channel, Category 
            ORDER BY "Fiscal Year"
        ) as prior_year
    FROM revenue_by_year
) subquery
